purpose: Full grid of all 21 case-study cards on /casestudies (no pagination, no filters). Field shape follows the real cases.json record exactly.
measuredFrom: spec/pages/casestudies/cases.json (21 cases, real field shape); spec/pages/casestudies-index.md

contentPolicy.note: All 21 records in cases.json reference REAL named third-party companies (Gallea AI, Smallest.ai, Klaar, etc.) and real named people. Card metadata (title/company/person/stats/excerpt) IS measured-real. The linked case study's long-form BODY, pull-quotes and testimonial are generated placeholder (see sections/content-article-body.json).

constraints.countNote: There are 21 case studies, not 22 — confirmed against sitemap.xml and Framer's search index (spec/pages/casestudies-index.md)

customer-logo.guidance: COMPLIANCE: real named companies' logos (logoImage field). Never AI-generate or alter; use licensed exact assets.

customer-photo.guidance: COMPLIANCE: avatarImage is a real named person's photo (e.g. Brandon Kay). Never generate a fabricated likeness; use the licensed real photo.

case-cover-image.guidance: coverImage is typically a branded/product screenshot; only AI-generate if not depicting a specific real customer's actual private product data.
